title: ROI editor — Camera #{{cameraId}}
frameMismatchWarning: This camera's resolution has changed since the slot map was drawn. Existing shapes were rescaled to fit - check alignment before saving.
saveWarmupBanner: Saved. Slots on this camera will read Unknown for a few frames while the worker rebuilds its vote filter from scratch - this is expected, not a failure.
saveBlockedInvalid: Fix the highlighted slots before saving: every slot needs at least 3 vertices, a real area, and a unique code.
unsavedChangesBody: You have unsaved changes to this slot map. Leaving now discards them.
shortcutDrawClick: Draw mode: click to add a vertex
shortcutCloseDraft: Double-click, Enter, or click the first vertex: close the polygon
shortcutCancelDraft: Esc: cancel the polygon being drawn
shortcutInsertVertex: Click a midpoint handle: insert a vertex
shortcutDeleteVertex: Del: delete the selected vertex, or the whole slot if one is selected
shortcutUndo: Ctrl+Z: undo - while drawing, steps back one point
shortcutZoom: Mouse wheel: zoom at the cursor
snapshotUnavailable: No snapshot is available for this camera right now.
deleteSlotConfirm: Delete this slot? It stays deletable until Save - nothing is removed from the server yet.
saveConfirmRemovedWarning: Removed codes permanently delete their occupancy history on save. This cannot be undone.
draftNeedsMore: {{count}} point(s) — at least {{min}} needed to finish
draftReady: {{count}} points — press Finish, or double-click, or Enter
